title.narrative: Further development of civil dialogue between Serbia and Kosovo

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to contribute in building a good neighbourly relations between Serbia and Kosovo through civil society.

The Specific Objectives (SOs) of this action are:

SO1. Establishment of cooperation of youth from Kosovo and Serbia in the areas of employment, education, environment and culture

SO2: Provide support for active engagement in civil dialogue of youth, women and national minorities in multi-ethnic communities in Serbia and Kosovo.
